chunks.text: [Arrival at the crest: instrumental, near-silent bowed breath, a fragile rising fiddle phrase emerging within two seconds; gentle opening into winter sunlight]
positive_styles: solo fiddle with natural bow texture

chunks.text: [The sea and the departing boat: instrumental, lift the same fiddle motif into one broad restrained swell; breathtaking beauty opening into the ache of being left alone; the cue's emotional high point]
positive_styles: same intimate fiddle and cello ensemble

chunks.text: [Turn back toward the lighthouse: instrumental, recede from the swell, thin the upper strings, settle into a quiet measured cello figure beneath the unfinished fiddle melody; responsibility and courage within solitude]

[Walking toward the station: instrumental, softer echoes of the same three-note motif over the warm cello, with space between phrases and a small trace of hope; keep the arrangement intimate and continue easing down]
[Natural instrumental ending: instruments fall away, leave a slightly unresolved open interval and its long clear acoustic decay; reach silence at the end]
